meta.title: letsylabs — Realtime voice infrastructure for AI, EU-compliant
meta.description: Realtime voice infrastructure for AI: audio, telephony, STT, TTS and an auditable compliance trail — self-hosted or in our cloud.

hero.h1: Give your AI a voice — on the phone and on the web.
hero.sub: Stream audio, transcribe in realtime, speak with low latency and route phone calls — connected to your own agent or LLM. Self-hosted or in our cloud. EU-compliant by design.

pipeline.text: We handle realtime media — transport, transcription, turn-taking, interruptions, speech and the audit trail. You decide what thinks. Connect your agent over HTTP + SSE, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
pipeline.hint: CLICK A SOURCE AND A DESTINATION TO REROUTE
pipeline.ariaLabel: Interactive pipeline diagram: audio sources connect through the letsylabs runtime to your agent or any LLM

voice.h2: Speech infrastructure without the agent lock-in.

stt.title: Realtime STT
stt.text: Partial transcripts in under 300 ms. Spanish first, multilingual by design.

tts.title: Streaming TTS
tts.text: First audio per sentence, not per response. Speech starts while the model is still thinking.

turns.title: Turn-taking & barge-in
turns.text: Interrupt the agent with your voice. The runtime handles turns so your code doesn't.

latency.title: Latency tracing
latency.text: Every segment measured, every conversation traced. Query the timeline per call.

telephony.h2: Turn any phone call into a programmable stream.
telephony.text: Bring your SIP trunk or PBX — Asterisk, 3CX, your carrier — and every call becomes a session your software controls. Inbound, outbound, transfers, DTMF.
telephony.claim: Use your carrier. Or ours, later. Never locked in.

compliance.h2: The law now requires it. We built it in.
compliance.text: Spain's Ley 10/2025 and the EU AI Act require AI callers to identify themselves, offer a human handoff and keep records. letsylabs ships these as infrastructure: automatic AI disclosure at call start, guaranteed transfer to a human, synthetic-audio marking and a certified, exportable audit log per call.

disclosure.title: AI disclosure
disclosure.text: The caller is told it's an AI at call start. Automatic, logged, verifiable.

handoff.title: Human handoff
handoff.text: A guaranteed transfer path to a person, on request or on rule.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.text: A certified, exportable event log per call. Every disclosure, every transfer.

retention.title: Retention controls
retention.text: Recording retention, deletion and rectification — configured, not coded.

selfHost.h2: Your infrastructure. Your data. One command.
selfHost.text: Run the entire platform on your servers with docker compose — including open-weight STT and TTS models, so audio never leaves your infrastructure. The same stack we run in our cloud.

openSource.text: The core contracts, VAD and open-weight model adapters are Apache 2.0. Build with the same types we build on — in Rust today, Python soon.

types.name: letsy-types
types.text: Session, event and audio-frame contracts. The types everything speaks.

vad.name: letsy-vad
vad.text: Voice activity detection tuned for conversation, not dictation.

adapters.name: letsy-adapters
adapters.text: Open-weight model adapters — Voxtral and friends.

vision.text: letsylabs is built as the interaction layer between intelligent software and the real world. We're shipping it one sense at a time.

finalCta.h2: Build voice AI that holds up in production — and in an audit.
finalCta.note: GA lands March 2027 · early-access pilots get founding terms
